flavor.prompt:
Write flavor for Digital Nomadia, a satirical social-combat card game.
Campaign: Swipe Right, Regret Later
Card: The Soft-Launch Detective (monster)
Current approved flavor: Enhance the reflection in the wine glass.
Original material and source references: []
Encounter themes: status, first_impressions
Voice: dry, observant, a little wounded; someone telling a friend how the date went. Let a specific object or awkward behavior carry the joke. Preserve an existing line when it already works.
Immutable gameplay contract: {"rules":"Beat strength 10: gain 1 level, 150 cash and 1 loot. Failed escape: lose 3 Chill.","effects":[],"strength":10,"rewards":{"cash_cp":150},"setback":3,"loot":1}

Return three alternatives, each no more than 25 words. You may also propose an optional 40–80 word extended vignette for future collection detail; it will not be displayed until an editor approves it. Keep original quotations exact and cite their source IDs. Do not invent facts about real players, new abilities, resource prices, or effects. Do not explain the punchline or replace a good joke just to make it different.

Return JSON: {"schemaVersion":2,"cardId":"monster_the_soft_launch_detective","candidates":[{"text":"...","sourceIds":[],"authorship":"new|adapted","note":"..."}],"extendedVignette":{"text":"...","sourceIds":[],"authorship":"new|adapted"}}. Every output is an editorial candidate. Approved flavor and gameplay remain unchanged until reviewed separately.

visual.prompt:
Write an illustration brief for a Digital Nomadia trading card.
Card: The Soft-Launch Detective (monster_the_soft_launch_detective)
Campaign: Swipe Right, Regret Later
Subject: An adult amateur detective in evening wear, carrying a jeweler's loupe
Visible action: Examining a wine glass reflection for a second person's hidden silhouette
Setting: A mixer table turned into a tiny investigation desk
Visual joke: A barely visible elbow has become a major case
Motifs: wine-glass reflection, loupe, cropped photographs without text
Composition: Large foreground wine glass acts as a lens; detective's intense eye is the secondary focal point
Palette: mint, lavender, peach, cyan, cream

Use the detail, staging, and dramatic light of a rich fantasy trading-card illustration. Translate the joke into contemporary social behavior. Use colorful Web 2.0 pastels: mint, lavender, peach, cyan, and warm cream. Keep one clear focal subject and a silhouette readable on a phone. People are fictional adults. Keep the proposed rendering style open for art direction.

The clean prompt must describe one visible scene. Do not paste the card name as lettering, source metadata, gameplay rules, or this writing assignment into it. Keep card frames, names, statistics, flavor text, and interface elements outside the image. Keep source jokes in the flavor workflow unless they describe something visible.

Return JSON with these fields: {"schemaVersion":2,"cardId":"monster_the_soft_launch_detective","brief":{"subject":"...","action":"...","setting":"...","visualJoke":"...","composition":"...","palette":[]},"cleanPrompt":"...","negativePrompt":"text, letters, numbers, captions, logos, watermarks, card frame, rules box, user interface","aspectRatio":"4:3","styleStatus":"provisional"}.
